description: Get a one-time launch URL for an external (LTI) tool in a course, so you can open it directly in a browser. Read-only. Get tool_id from list_external_tools. The URL expires quickly.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tool_id.description: External tool ID (numeric string). Get it from list_external_tools.

url.description: Optional launch URL of a specific tool resource, if the tool needs one.

name: get_tool_launch_url
title: Get Tool Launch URL
